integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from bibliographic comparisons; no numerical experiment is used to establish the infinite-tail claim.
scientific_limitations: The construction treats the unit-rate exponential target only.
It does not place the factors in long-tailed, regularly varying, or subexponential subclasses.
Search cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent analytic regularization.
title: Real-analytic heavy tails with an exactly exponential minimum
